title: Audio Editor Service State
description: Accumulates a rolling window of incoming audio and provides playback and editing of the recorded audio. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/audioeditor)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of samples to retain (default = 60 s at 48 kHz)

action.description: "clear" resets the buffer; "play" triggers playback of a selection
